title: S. Gifford Nielsen
vital_facts: Baptized as a child, Aaronic Priesthood as a youth, Melchizedek Priesthood as a young adult
Married Wendy Kay Olson, April 23, 1975, in the Provo Utah Temple; six children.
Bachelor's degree from Brigham Young University in 1978
Quarterback, Houston Oilers, 1978-1984; Sports Director, KHOU-TV 25 years. Chairman of Memorial City Bank.
Elders Quorum President, Mission President's Counselor, Bishop, Stake President, and Area Seventy.
First Quorum of the Seventy 2013 - present
accuracy_caveat: Community-compiled biographies from gapages.com (offline since 2023). Recovered from the Wayback Machine. Cross-reference with official Church sources.
